title: Codex fan-out structured result
description: Reference JSON-Schema for the fanout-json profile's `--output-schema` (spec G5). Each detached `codex exec --json` fan-out worker returns an object matching this schema so the orchestrator can fan-in typed results without prose parsing. Extend per campaign; this is the conventional default.

id.description: Caller-assigned work-unit id, echoed back for fan-in correlation.

status.description: Terminal state of this fan-out unit (AGENTS.md §4 terminal-state convention).

artifacts.description: Absolute paths to files this unit produced.
